description: This file defines types, decision logic, and functions related to failover policies in an embedded agent system, including decision actions, parameters, and resolution functions.

methods.name: shouldEscalateRetryLimit
methods.description: Determines if the retry limit should be escalated based on the failover reason.

methods.name: shouldRotatePrompt
methods.description: Decides if the prompt should be rotated based on failover failure and reason.

methods.name: shouldRotateAssistant
methods.description: Determines if the assistant should rotate based on various failover parameters.

methods.name: mergeRetryFailoverReason
methods.description: Merges previous and current failover reasons, considering timeout.

methods.name: resolveRunFailoverDecision
methods.description: Resolves and returns the appropriate failover decision based on input parameters.
